description: Matériel, roulant ferroviaire de la Région des Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Liste du Matériel, roulant ferroviaire régional. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Trains, TER. The portal shows 11 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
